facts.fact: Mauritius Telecom launched its my.t cloud enterprise cloud services (including Elastic Cloud Servers) at a ceremony on 27 March 2024 at its Rose Belle Data Centre, which hosts them for business customers.

Mauritius Telecom's CEO stated that the Rose Belle Data Centre is certified Tier IV (over Rs 1 billion invested); the document does not name the certifying body; the date is the article's publication date.
